name: Indian Sucrose Limited
about: Indian Sucrose Limited manufactures and sells sugar and allied products in India. It operates through two segments: Sugar and Cogeneration of Power. The company offers sugar under the Sweeto and Yadu brand names, as well as bagasse and molasses. It also engages in the cogeneration of power. The company was formerly known as Oswal Sugars Limited and changed its name to Indian Sucrose Limited. Indian Sucrose Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Delhi, India.
